# GALLERY (gallery)

A dark portfolio index — woven palette threads behind a grid of swatch cards.

- **Technique:** WOVEN CANVAS
- **Tags:** portfolio, index, collection, dark, grid, showcase
- **Best for:** portfolios; product catalogs; link hubs
- **Fonts:** Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,300;1,9..144,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #08080d · #e8c168 · #ecebe6
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/gallery/` (.claude, Template.astro, content.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css, weave.ts)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* gallery — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --bg: #08080d;
  --bg2: #0d0d15;
  --card: #111119;
  --tx: #ecebe6;
  --dim: #9a99a6;
  --faint: #55545f;
  --gold: #e8c168;
  --scroll-thumb: #22222e;
  --serif: "Fraunces", serif;
  --sans: "Inter", sans-serif;
  --mono: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `weave.ts`
  - `weave(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Woven-threads background: 26 slow sine "threads" stroked in colors sampled from the gallery items. Colors arrive as a JSON array in `data-colors`.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

export interface GalleryItem {
  /** Big italic number on the swatch, e.g. "01". */
  no: string;
  name: string;
  summary: string;
  /** Pill in the swatch's top-right corner. */
  tag: string;
  /** Three swatch stripes; the middle one widens on hover. Also feeds the woven background. */
  swatch: [string, string, string];
  href: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Wordmark in nav + footer. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    subHtml: string;
    primary: Link;
    secondary?: Link;
    note?: string;
  };
  /** Anchor id for the grid section (nav/CTA links target `#${gridId}`). */
  gridId: string;
  items: GalleryItem[];
  about: { headingHtml: string; bodyHtml: string };
  footer: { brandNoteHtml: string; creditHtml: string };
}
```

## Use it
- Full site: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs template gallery --out <dir>`
- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style gallery --out <dir>`
